english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for someone's outward look or general bearing when no narrower meaning is intended.

examples.english: Your cheerful mien today makes me wonder if something good happened.
examples.traditional: 你今日個樣咁精神，係咪有咩開心事呀？
